purpose: Post-hoc method development prompted by the observable-subgroup audit: compare a frozen hierarchical Mondrian calibration rule with the existing global split-conformal rule on identical outer evaluation cases.

development_boundary.reason: The grouping method was designed after observable subgroup instability had been inspected.
development_boundary.required_next_confirmation: Any positive development result must be frozen and confirmed on new untouched data or independently judged flood-domain data before deployment review.

frozen_model_protocol.sufficiency_head: One global class-balanced deterministic IRLS head is fitted on each train split.

mondrian_calibration.calibration_unit: Maximum incomplete-variant sufficiency score within each calibration case family.
mondrian_calibration.declaration_rule: Declare complete only when the variant score is strictly greater than the selected threshold.

theoretical_scope.groupwise_statement: A finite-sample groupwise marginal statement requires exchangeability within the exact calibration group whose threshold is used.
theoretical_scope.fallback_statement: A fallback threshold does not create a conditional guarantee for a more specific subgroup that lacked calibration support.

gate_policy: This post-hoc development experiment cannot change Gate 2 from NO-GO/SHADOW and cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
